
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/halfcode/p/20143984" title="发布于 2026-05-24 19:58">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">22. LangChain LCEL，用 | 串联AI的魔法语言</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>在 <span class="words-blog hl-git-1" data-tit="LangChain" data-pretit="langchain">LangChain 生态中，LCEL（LangChain Expression Language）是一种新的编程范式。它用一个简单的|，改变了 AI 应用的构建方式。曾经需要编写大量胶水代码才能串联起来的提示词、模型和输出解析器，现在只需要一行代码就能完成：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>chain = prompt | model | parser</pre>
</div>
<p><strong>1. LCEL 核心原理：| 运算符的秘密</strong><br>LCEL 的核心设计哲学就是 "数据流优先"。所有组件都遵循统一的接口，数据从左向右沿着链条自动流动，无需开发者手动处理中间状态。</p>
<p>链式组合：LCEL 使用|（竖线）运算符串联 Prompt、模型与输出解析器形成 AI 流水线，数据严格按照从左到右的顺序传递。</p>
<p>底层实现：| 运算符本质上是 Python 中__or__方法的语法糖。</p>
<p>Runnable 基类：LangChain 中所有可执行组件都继承自Runnable基类，该基类重载了__or__方法，这就是为什么所有组件都能使用|进行链式组合的根本原因。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202605/1919157-20260524195505789-1152269571.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><strong>&nbsp;2. 三步构建你的第一条 AI 链</strong></p>
<p>下面，让我们从最简单的例子开始，用 LCEL 构建一个笑话生成器。这个例子将展示 LCEL 最核心的用法：串联提示词、模型和<span class="words-blog hl-git-1" data-tit="字符串" data-pretit="字符串">字符串输出解析器。</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> dotenv <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> load_dotenv
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> langchain.chat_models <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> init_chat_model

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> langchain_core.output_parsers <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> StrOutputParser
 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 加载环境变量（包含API密钥、模型名称等）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">load_dotenv()
 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 初始化模型（使用config_prefix支持多模型配置）</span>
prefix = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">QWEN</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

    model_provider</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">openai</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    configurable_fields</span>=[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">model</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">api_key</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">base_url</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">],
    config_prefix</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">prefix,
    temperature</span>=0.5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    max_tokens</span>=500<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
)
 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 模型配置（从环境变量中读取）</span>
config =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">configurable</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
        f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{prefix}_model</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: os.getenv(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{prefix}_MODEL</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
        f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{prefix}_api_key</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: os.getenv(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{prefix}_API_KEY</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
        f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{prefix}_base_url</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: os.getenv(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{prefix}_BASE_URL</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    }
}
 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建提示词模板</span>

    [
        {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">system</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">你是一个笑话大王</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 用LCEL构建完整链条</span>

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(result)</pre>
</div>
<p><strong>3. 进阶用法：什么可以入链？</strong><br>LCEL 的强大之处在于它的包容性。几乎任何逻辑都可以被包装成 Runnable 组件，然后无缝接入流水线。但有一个核心规则必须牢记：</p>
<p>入链的内容必须是 Runnable 的子类，字典的值也必须符合这个规则。</p>
<p>下面是不同数据类型的处理方式对照表：</p>
<p>数据类型	处理方式	对应 Runnable子类	核心作用<br>静态值	包装为lambda _: 静态值	RunnableLambda	生成固定值<br>函数/lambda表达式	直接使用（自动转换）	RunnableLambda	执行自定义逻辑<br>动态值	使用RunnablePassthrough()	RunnablePassthrough	原样传递数据<br>字典	直接使用，值也要符合规范	RunnableParallel	并行执行多分支<br>让我们用一个例子来演示这些规则。我们将构建一个能生成结构化 JSON 数据的 AI 链，这在实际应用中非常常见。</p>
<p>RunnablePassthrough()：当你直接传入字符串"请描述一下张三..."时，RunnablePassthrough()会将这个字符串原样传递给new_input变量。</p>
<p>lambda _: parser.get_format_instructions()：这里的下划线_表示我们不关心上游输入，因为格式指令是固定的。这个 lambda 会被自动转换为RunnableLambda。</p>
<p>字典入链：整个字典会被转换为RunnableParallel对象，它会并行执行所有键对应的 Runnable，然后将结果合并为一个新的字典传递给下一个组件（这里是 prompt）。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> dotenv <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> load_dotenv
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> langchain.chat_models <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> init_chat_model

</div>
<h4>4. 函数入链：无缝集成自定义逻辑</h4>
<p>LCEL 最强大的特性之一就是可以轻松将任意 Python 函数接入流水线。函数会被自动转换为RunnableLambda，无需任何额外的包装代码。</p>
<p>让我们扩展上一个例子，添加一个函数将生成的 JSON 数据自动保存到本地文件。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> json
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> dotenv <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> load_dotenv
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> langchain.chat_models <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> init_chat_model
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> langchain_core.prompts <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ChatPromptTemplate
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> langchain_core.output_parsers <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> JsonOutputParser
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> langchain_core.runnables <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RunnablePassthrough
 
load_dotenv()
 
prefix </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">QWEN</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
model </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> init_chat_model(
    model_provider</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">openai</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    configurable_fields</span>=[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">model</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">api_key</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">base_url</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">],

    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">configurable</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
        f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{prefix}_model</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: os.getenv(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{prefix}_MODEL</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
        f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{prefix}_api_key</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: os.getenv(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{prefix}_API_KEY</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
        f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{prefix}_base_url</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: os.getenv(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{prefix}_BASE_URL</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    }
}
 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 自定义函数：保存JSON数据到文件</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> save_json(data, filename=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">output.json</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
        with open(filename, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">w</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, encoding=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">utf-8</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) as f:
            json.dump(data, f, ensure_ascii</span>=False, indent=4<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">JSON数据已成功保存到 {filename}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">except</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Exception as e:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">保存JSON文件时出错: {e}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> data  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 重要：返回数据以便继续传递给下一个组件</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 
parser </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> JsonOutputParser()
prompt </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ChatPromptTemplate.from_messages(
    [
        {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">system</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">你是一位有10年经验的资深软件工程师。{format_instructions}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
        {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{new_input}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
    ]
)
 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 将自定义函数直接加入链条</span>
chain =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ({
             </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">new_input</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: RunnablePassthrough(),
             </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">format_instructions</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">lambda</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _: parser.get_format_instructions()
         }
         </span>|<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> prompt
         </span>|<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> model
         </span>|<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> parser
         </span>| save_json  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 函数直接入链</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">         )
 
result </span>= chain.invoke(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">请描述一下张三这个人，包括姓名、年龄、职业和兴趣爱好。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, config=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">config)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(result)</pre>
</div>
<p>运行这段代码后，你会在当前目录下看到一个output.json文件，内容如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">姓名</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">张三</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">年龄</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: 30<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">职业</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">软件工程师</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">兴趣爱好</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: [
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">阅读技术书籍</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">徒步旅行</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">围棋</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    ]
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>重要提示：自定义函数必须返回数据，这样数据才能继续传递给链条中的下一个组件。如果函数没有返回值（返回None），那么链条的后续组件将收到None作为输入。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
